scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with independent finite computations. Published two-projection theory and elementary alternating-cycle identities are acknowledged; publication priority is a best-knowledge assessment, not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for complex (or complexified real) centered edge-only Parseval frames from complete graphs on even n >= 4 and binary coarse-grainings selected by perfect matchings; excludes general frames, irregular graphs, and arbitrary masks.
title: Alternating-cycle spectra and sharp noncommutativity of matching-coarse-grained Parseval frames
